Chris (Support): FYI we have a Lodestar Labs billing dispute — they say they were charged for duplicate ingestion calls last night. Invoice INV-2026-0453 linked here: https://app.redwood.com/invoices/INV-2026-0453
Mike (Finance): @Chris can you drop the short calc and the timeframe? we need a number to review.
Chris (Support): Root cause looks like a client-side retry loop + our webhook retried once -> ended up double-ingesting ~22:30-23:10 UTC. Quick snapshot from logs: `duplicate_calls=1, extra_tokens=2100000, est_cost=$1320`
Anya (Customer Ops): Lodestar asked for a full reversal of the incremental charges + a goodwill credit for the outage. They called out lost dev time.
Mike (Finance): For billing ops, we usually fix the invoice to remove the duplicated usage and consider goodwill separately. Propose: auto-correct usage (-$1,320) + goodwill $1,000 (total $2,320) — does that match ops/legal guidelines?
Chris (Support): That aligns with their ask. They explicitly requested: correct invoice + one-time goodwill to cover engineering hours. They can accept a two-line credit on the next invoice.
Anya (Customer Ops): I'm +1 for the usage correction. For goodwill $1k I need Janelle sign-off (policy says >$500 requires FM approval).
Mike (Finance): OK looping in Janelle. @Janelle can you approve GL code and the $1,000 goodwill? GL proposed: `FIN-CR-01`.
Janelle (Finance Lead): I reviewed logs and the support thread. Approve the usage correction and $1,000 goodwill. Use GL `FIN-CR-01`. Please keep a short note in the ticket explaining cause = client retry + webhook retry.
billing-bot: Created credit TKT-9876, amount: $2,320, GL: FIN-CR-01. Scheduled apply date: 2026-03-25.
Mike (Finance): I'll process the manual credit this afternoon and mark INV-2026-0453 as adjusted. Recording: `adj:TKT-9876` in billing system.
Chris (Support): Thanks all — Lodestar ops notified. I'll ask them to confirm when the credit posts and follow up if anything odd shows on their end. :thumbsup:
Anya (Customer Ops): Copying a short customer message they sent: "Appreciate the quick fix — the credit will help offset the time we lost."
Mike (Finance): All done from finance side; credit queued. Closing thread once Lodestar confirms receipt.
Chris (Support): noted — closing on confirmation.
